BASE_DOMAIN.description: Your control hostname, for example tunnel.example.net. It must be in a Cloudflare zone you control.

VISITOR_DOMAIN.description: The parent DNS zone for visitor URLs, for example example.net. Visitors use <tunnel-id>-tunnel.example.net.

OPERATOR_TOKEN.description: Generate a long random secret. The CLI uses this to create tunnels. Never use the placeholder value from .dev.vars.example.
